channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Judge allows 'homewrecker' lawsuit against former Senator Kyrsten Sinema to proceed
item.description: A judge ruled that messages from Kyrsten Sinema establish jurisdiction, allowing a lawsuit under North Carolina's alienation of affection law.

item.title: Democratic operative sentenced in child sex abuse sting
item.description: A former Virginia Democratic finance chair and DNC delegate received a decade in prison for child sexual abuse material and related charges.

item.title: Arizona voter law dispute reaches Supreme Court with potential 'absurd' outcome
item.description: Election experts warn the Supreme Court that a Ninth Circuit ruling could make it impossible to remove noncitizens from state voter rolls.

item.title: Former Gov. Pataki: Domestic threats now endanger freedoms
item.description: Former New York Gov. George Pataki said the freedoms targeted on 9/11 are now under internal pressure, arguing that the threat is domestic.
